status: design-locked v1 prior (batch-3 R2 lifecycle-eval) — machine-readable §13.2 thresholds + §13.1 item→category map; the per-item category assignments are PRIORS (the §13.2 7 categories are themselves '默认 prior'), refinable via the §13 calibration mechanism

notes.why: the §13.2 thresholds are PROSE so they cannot be compared mechanically; this authority pins the machine-readable per-category threshold + governs each §13.1 item's category, so the (private, mutable) lifecycle_register can NOT self-author / lower its own review threshold (R-USSHORT-BATCH3-R2-LIFECYCLE-THRESHOLD-SELF-AUTHORING-BYPASS). The lifecycle eval DERIVES each item's threshold from this authority by number.
notes.count_type_choice: for the OR category 'scoring weight' (§13.2 '≥12 周 forward 或 ≥30 有效样本') the conservative primary 'weeks≥12' is pinned (the ≥30-samples alternative is a future refinement; weeks≥12 is stricter, never earlier-due).
notes.secondary_required: true encodes the §13.2 qualitative add-on (人工复核 / 覆盖≥2 regimes / 口径一致性 / 交叉确认 / 复审效应 / 双向全口径) — when true, an item is due only with secondary_condition_met.
notes.item_category_priors: items that do not cleanly fit one of the 7 §13.2 categories (benchmark / 纸面成本 / 现金分配 / 跳空带宽 / 财报趋势 / …) are assigned a best-fit PRIOR + default to the conservative 'scoring weight' (weeks≥12, no secondary); the full map is const-pinned in the schema, so refining a prior is a REVIEWED §13-calibration version bump (no silent same-shape remap), do not treat as final.
